romanized_title: [Bad Things Anthology] The Husband Next Door
description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/next_husband), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/next_husband) 

After realizing her husband is cheating, Jieun hides the truth and goes on living in a hollow marriage, pretending to be happy and lying to herself. But just as she is struggling while watching her husband grow colder by the day, she ends up witnessing him kissing his mistress together with Seongho, the man who just moved in next door. “They say the best way to forget cheating is with cheating. Wouldn’t I be better than a cheating husband?” After that, she finds herself completely swept up by Seongho, the man next door who keeps getting closer and closer to her…
